env.userData: fresh empty temporary directory via AETHER_TEST_USER_DATA (interactive run: $TMPDIR/ud-p2-places; this list replayed whole: $TMPDIR/ud-p2-places-replay)
env.build: main at 7a04adf (was ca6394b before the 2026-09-26 rewrite) + the uncommitted rev 6 phase 2 working tree, with this run's fixes (see result.md)
env.injected: Two writes, both evals: (1) the two places of the interactive run (a side-scroller p1 '青苔石階路' seed 2620891176 and a dungeon p2 '舊礦道' seed 2460322787, the programs and residents' words the model wrote there, stored in the save) are added with useLandStore.addPlace at chunks (1,0) and (0,1) instead of asking the model again, so the places are identical on every replay; (2) chapter e1's stage is set to kind 'side' with p1's program on seed 1234567 (the built-in story has no climb or maze). Everything else is keys (hold), the virtual pad's stick for walking the land along the fords (pad.toward), clicks on dialogue choices, and read-only evals: the helpers read the place view's own body refs through React's fiber and route with the app's own gridMaze/gridOpen/sideCourse.
env.note: New game rolls a random land seed, so the walks go along the chunk-centre ford rows and columns (always walkable). Inside the places everything is deterministic from the stored seeds.

model: none at interaction time. openai gpt-5.4-mini (Settings -> Model default on a fresh userData, key from .env) writes the built-in world's witnessings and chapter 1 in the background while this runs; no call is made for a place, a talk or a chest.

actions.eval: (async()=>{const S=await import('/state/index.ts'); for(let i=0;i<120;i++){const s=S.useSessionStore.getState(); if(s.screen==='play'&&s.activeInstance) return {ms:Date.now()-window.__e2e.t0, cartridge:s.activeInstance.instance.save.cartridge}; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));} return null})()

", "dialogues": {"mine_lost": "root = Dialogue("mine_lost", "外頭還冷嗎？我在這裡轉了兩圈，還是找不到南邊那段路。", [c1, c2, c3])

  return (S.useLandStore.getState().progress.places || []).map((p) => [p.id, p.kind, p.title, p.cx, p.cz, p.seed]);
